title: Lazy Loading & Code Splitting
description: Split your app into chunks and load components only when needed.

slides.title: Why Lazy Load?
slides.content:
# Reduce Initial Bundle Size

By default, a Vue app bundles all components together. For large apps, the initial load can be heavy. **Code splitting** breaks the bundle into chunks that are loaded only when required.

In Vue Router, you can lazily load route components:

```javascript
const routes = [
  {
    path: '/dashboard',
    component: () => import('./views/Dashboard.vue')
  }
]
```

The `import()` function returns a promise, and the component is loaded only when the route is visited.
